title: 2026-10-28 AI结构性变革：上下文压缩突破、边缘浏览器推理、机器人融资激增与监管挑战
core_insight: 模型在上下文压缩与能量驱动学习上的突破，加上边缘浏览器推理和机器人融资激增，标志着AI正从中心化大模型向高效长文本处理和去中心化物理部署双向跃迁。

dimension_texts.technology: Context length成本大幅降低，线性时间压缩使长文本处理更高效；SLICE-Mem通过显著性门控实现轻量化记忆，提升LLM代理的长期上下文保持能力。 引入状态空间编码的线性时间上下文压缩、能量驱动的可扩展基础学习模型，以及记忆‑中心的显著性门控代理架构。 Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners TraceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory The Social World Model Evaluation Gap
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 本地浏览器推理显著降低每查询成本并削减云端计算开支。 向边缘计算转移，浏览器利用本地CPU/GPU，降低对集中式GPU农场的依赖。 Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
dimension_texts.application: 医疗呼叫中心、企业业务应用、实时世界模拟、机器人制造与物流、以及在浏览器中运行的消费级AI应用均出现原生AI解决方案。 AI原生语音客服取代传统SaaS呼叫中心，边缘AI取代云端AI服务，机器人解决方案冲击传统自动化供应商。 Anima helps clinics cut call waits by 75% with GPT-6 and GPT-Live Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering Crunchbase Data Shows Q3 Robotics Startup Funding Jumps 185% As US And China Lead Physical AI Push Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
